title: Camera with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Camera body -->
  <rect x='15' y='30' width='70' height='50' rx='8' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- Camera body lighter top piece -->
  <rect x='15' y='30' width='70' height='12' rx='8' fill='#6BB3F0'/>
  <rect x='15' y='38' width='70' height='6' fill='#6BB3F0'/>
  <!-- Flash / viewfinder bump -->
  <rect x='55' y='22' width='18' height='12' rx='3' fill='#3A7BC8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='24' width='4' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <!-- Lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='18' fill='#2C5F9E'/>
  <!-- Lens inner -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='14' fill='#1A3D6E'/>
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='9' fill='#5BA3E8'/>
  <!-- Lens highlight -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='51' r='3.5' fill='#A8D4FF'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on camera body area (around lens but offset) -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='50' r='3' fill='#FFF9C4'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M34 62 Q50 74 66 62' stroke='#FFF9C4' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Shutter button -->
  <rect x='22' y='24' width='12' height='8' rx='4' fill='#FF7043'/>
  <rect x='24' y='26' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF9A76'/>
  <!-- Strap holders -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='45' r='3' fill='#2C5F9E'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='45' r='3' fill='#2C5F9E'/>
  <!-- Blush marks -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='62' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8A80' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
